title: Rise | A Community Service Partnership (also known as NJ Rise)
description:
Nonprofit community organization in Hightstown, New Jersey. Supports families and residents of eastern Mercer County with food assistance, case management, youth programs, a thrift store, and emergency support. Serving the community since 1967.Once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator.
